item.title: Fastbuy Recalls Zimtown Portable Gas and Fuel Cans Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard and Child Poisoning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Portable Fuel Containers
item.company: Online at Walmart.com and Zimtown.com from May 2026 through July 2026 for between $32 and $63.
item.brand: Online at Walmart.com and Zimtown.com from May 2026 through July 2026 for between $32 and $63.
item.product: Zimtown Portable Gas and Fuel Cans
item.summary: This recall involves Zimtown Portable "Jerry" style Gas and Fuel Cans with spout. The metal 5.0 gallon (20L) fuel cans come in red and army green. The cans have a white spout and yellow vent cap. The assembled product dimensions are 4.76 x 8.49 x 19.29 inches.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Zimtown Portable Gas and Fuel Cans.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the gas and fuel containers immediately and contact Fastbuy for a full refund. Consumers should disassemble the spout, cut it into pieces with scissors and dispose of it separately from the container. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" on the container and submit photos of the product to ZimtownFuelCanrecall@outlook.com separately.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
